description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for verifying the behavior of 'safe.bareRepository' configurations in Git, including setup of repositories, configuration checks, and validation of different scenarios related to bare repositories and worktrees.

methods.name: expect_accepted_implicit
methods.description: Checks if a command with implicit repository detection is accepted and logs performance trace.

methods.name: expect_accepted_explicit
methods.description: Checks if a command with explicit GIT_DIR is accepted and logs performance trace.

methods.name: expect_rejected
methods.description: Checks if a command expected to fail with certain error messages and logs performance trace.
